newsitem.title: UK: Amersham closes at record high.
newsitem.headline: Amersham closes at record high.

text.p: Shares in British healthcare and technology group Amersham International Plc rose to record levels on Thursday as the market focused on the likely benefits of its dual merger strategy.
Shares in Amersham jumped by 72 1/2 pence to a record closing high of 18.90 stg as it continued a week-long rally.

The stock has risen by 27 percent since it announced plans to merge its Life Science division with Pharmacia Biotech on June 10, and by 12.3 percent since the July 1 announcement of a full merger with Norway's Nycomed SA .
It started the year at 11.74 stg.
Despite initial gains, the stock fell back to touch 640 pence in the weeks after the Nycomed deal before resuming its onward march last week.
Analysts noted, however, the stock was very tightly traded. Thursday's gain was on the back of trading volumes of below 300,000 shares.
"It is up as (investors) turn their minds to the deals and the fact that they are building world leadership in two core areas," said SocGen analyst Alyson Coates.
Coates said the potential for cost savings and added profits from both mergers was great. "The risks they are taking on are strategically very sensible."
Nycomed, which analysts said had been having a difficult time in some key markets, is scheduled to publish second-quarter results on August 7.
